NRI Corner — for Indians living abroad

Remittance · NRE / NRO · Gold abroad vs India · English, for every country

💸 Sending money home — Remittance

Compare the exchange rate and the fee together before you send — a “zero fee” transfer with a poor rate can cost more than a small fee with a good rate. Check how long it takes, and whether the rate is locked when you book. Use the converter above to check what your family should receive.

🏦 NRE / NRO accounts — the short version

NRE: for money earned abroad, kept in rupees; interest is generally tax-free in India and funds are freely repatriable. NRO: for income earned in India (rent, pension); tax rules apply. FCNR: foreign-currency deposits, no rupee risk. Rules change — confirm with your bank before opening or moving large sums.

🪙 Gold in the Gulf vs India

World gold price is the same everywhere — what differs is making charges, local tax / VAT, and import duty when you bring it to India. Compare the total bill (gold + making + tax + duty), not the per-gram board price. Dubai, Singapore and Chennai prices are all on this page for that comparison.

NRI checklist before you act: check today’s rate in the converter · compare total cost, not headline price · keep receipts for gold and transfers · ask your bank / a licensed adviser about tax — this page explains, it does not advise. Not financial advice.

Newsroom standards · செய்தி அறை நெறிமுறைகள்

Five commitments every story on this site is held to — in English, with a Tamil gloss.

  1. Wire stories open on XELV — never away from it. Every wire headline opens right here with our own original brief, the source credited by name and the time shown; we never send you to another website to read the news. செய்திகள் இங்கேயே திறக்கும் — வேறு தளத்துக்கு அனுப்ப மாட்டோம்.
  2. Prices are checked against published rates and labelled with their date. விலைகள் வெளியிடப்பட்ட விலைகளுடன் சரிபார்க்கப்பட்டு, தேதியுடன் குறிக்கப்படும்.
  3. Financial content is information, not advice. நிதி உள்ளடக்கம் தகவல் மட்டுமே, ஆலோசனை அல்ல.
  4. Errors are corrected openly — see our . பிழைகள் வெளிப்படையாகத் திருத்தப்படும்.
  5. Ads are always labelled and never disguised as news. விளம்பரங்கள் எப்போதும் “Advertisement” என்று குறிக்கப்படும்; செய்தி போல் காட்டப்படாது.
